_note: Only NEX1 (bodo-helgeland) and NEX2 (bodo-svolvaer-bodo) have a documented, citable tender/research benchmark (NF17-2025, years 2022-2024) -- see data/reference/tender_disruption_claims.md. All other routes show pipeline_2025 figures with no comparison benchmark, stated explicitly rather than fabricated.

pipeline_2025.method_note: cancellation_days/delay_days = distinct 2025 calendar dates with >=1 trip in that status, from this pipeline's own AIS-vs-schedule matching -- not directly comparable methodology to NF17-2025's operator-self-reported avviksrapporter (see tender_context below). avg_delay_min is a simple mean, kept only for direct comparability with NF17's own mean-based figure -- it is skewed upward by a small number of severe (multi-hour) delays. median_delay_min is the more representative 'typical delayed trip' figure; prefer it when NF17 context isn't in view.
